jobs.title: Site Engineer - Albab (Dir Hafir)
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose**

The Site Engineer is responsible for the day-to-day supervision and technical oversight of (Health and Education) construction and rehabilitation activities, ensuring all works are implemented according to approved designs, specifications, quality standards, and project timelines. The role includes conducting site assessments, preparing technical measurements and work plans, monitoring contractor performance, and verifying completed works. The Site Engineer ensures compliance with health, safety, and environmental requirements while maintaining accurate site records and progress reports. They coordinate closely with project teams, local authorities, contractors, and community representatives to address technical issues and facilitate smooth implementation. Additionally, the Site Engineer supports quality control, documentation, and handover processes to ensure the sustainability and functionality of (Health and Education) infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Field Supervision & Technical Oversight: Provide daily field supervision for all civil, structural, and finishing works (including blockwork, plastering, tiling, painting, and waterproofing) to ensure strict adherence to the Bill of Quantities (BoQ), approved drawings, and technical specifications.
2. Site Assessment & Planning: Conduct initial site assessments to verify existing conditions (e.g., structural cracks, damaged plaster, existing plumbing/electrical networks) and prepare work plans and technical measurements accordingly.
3. Contractor Performance & Quantity Verification: Monitor contractor activities, verify executed quantities, and measure completed works against the BoQ to certify payment milestones. Document any deviations or non-conforming works and report them immediately.
4. Structural & Finishing Supervision: Supervise and verify the execution of concrete works (footings, columns, slabs), masonry, and precise finishing works such as ceramic/cement tiling, marble installation, and painting to ensure high-quality workmanship.
5. Quality Control & Materials Testing: Verify the quality of all materials delivered to the site (e.g., cement, steel, blocks, tiles, paints, waterproofing membranes) and ensure they match the approved submittals and technical specifications. Witness concrete testing and compaction tests as required.
6. Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Compliance: Ensure that the contractor strictly adheres to safety procedures during excavation, concrete casting, welding, and other high-risk activities. Enforce environmental regulations regarding dust control and debris management.
7. Reporting & Documentation: Maintain accurate site records, including daily logs, site diaries, and photographic documentation. Prepare periodic progress reports detailing completed works, technical observations, and challenges.
8. Site Handover & Acceptance: Supervise interim and final acceptance of works, ensuring all defects and punch-list items are rectified by the contractor before formal handover. Ensure the sustainability and functionality of the rehabilitated infrastructure.
9. Coordination & Stakeholder Engagement: Coordinate effectively with project teams (Program, Logistics, Procurement), local authorities, and community representatives to resolve technical issues, facilitate site access, and ensure smooth project implementation
10. Perform any other related duties and responsibilities as assigned by the line manager within the scope of work.

**Note: The key responsibilities listed above are indicative and not exhaustive. Additional responsibilities may be assigned to the position in the future, depending on the organizational structure and management requirements.**

**Qualification (Education/Work Experience)**

**Essential Qualifications**

1. Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related field.
2. At least 2 years of professional experience in supervising civil works, infrastructure, or construction projects.
3. Practical experience in field supervision of excavation works, concrete foundations, and contractor follow-up.
4. Good command of the English language.

**Desirable Qualifications**

1. Experience working in infrastructure rehabilitation projects, schools, or health centers.
2. Experience in reviewing Bills of Quantities (BoQs), drawings, and technical specifications, as well as measuring and accepting completed works.
3. Proficiency in AutoCAD and Microsoft Office applications.

**Core & Managerial Competencies**

1. **Core Competencies:**

- Communication
- Teamwork
- Planning and organizing
- Accountability
- Creativity
- Stakeholder Orientation
- Commitment to Continuous Learning
- Technological Awareness.

1. **Supervisor/Managerial Competencies:**

- Leadership
- Building Trust
- Vision
- Managing Performance
- Empowering Others
- Judgment/Decision-making.

1. **Technical Competencies:**

- Good knowledge of excavation works, preparation of foundation pits, and casting and construction of concrete foundations.
- Ability to read and interpret drawings, Bills of Quantities (BoQs), and technical specifications, and compare them with the actual implementation on site.
- Good knowledge of civil works quality control methods and monitoring of executed quantities.
- Ability to follow up with contractors, document technical observations, and monitor the implementation of corrective actions.
- Good skills in report writing and field documentation.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.

**Compliance to Anti-Harassment, PSEA, and Child Safeguarding**

- Child abuse in all forms is unacceptable to IYD, which recognizes its responsibility to protect children from harm in all areas of its work. IYD is committed to ensuring a child-safe environment and is applying a zero-tolerance approach towards any kind of child abuse and exploitation.
- IYD employees and related personnel must not under any circumstances take part in any form of discrimination, harassment, or abuse (physical, sexual or verbal), intimidation or exploitation, or in any other way infringe the rights of others inside or outside IYD.

jobs.title: Outreach Officer – Child Protection and Support to Vulnerable Families
jobs.description:
As part of a consortium, Habibi Association is implementing an AICS-funded project under the *Integrated Emergency Programme for Child Protection and Support to Vulnerable Families in Jordan*.The project aims to strengthen the protection and resilience of refugee and Jordanian children and their caregivers through integrated services, income support, capacity building and community mobilisation in Amman, Zarqa, Mafraq and Madaba.Within the consortium, Habibi is responsible for activities aimed at improving access to inclusive, gender-sensitive child protection services and strengthening the economic resilience of vulnerable households through vocational training and support for income-generating activities.To support the implementation of these activities, Habibi Association is seeking an **Outreach Officer** to support outreach, community engagement and beneficiary identification, working under the supervision of the Project Manager and in coordination with consortium partners and relevant local stakeholders.

## **2. Key Responsibilities**

Reporting to the MEAL Officer and/or the Project Manager, the Outreach Officer will be responsible for the following:

**A. Outreach and beneficiary identification**

- Support the development and implementation of the project’s outreach plan in collaboration with consortium partners and local civil society organisations.
- Identify and engage potential beneficiaries in accordance with the project’s eligibility and targeting criteria.
- Conduct beneficiary outreach and data collection using the tools and procedures established by the project.
- Ensure that information collected is accurate, complete and properly recorded, including through the use of tablets or other digital tools.
- Explain the purpose of data collection and obtain informed consent before collecting or recording personal information.
- Identify cases requiring referral and report them to the designated project focal point in accordance with established referral procedures.
- Ensure the confidentiality and secure handling of beneficiary information, in compliance with data protection, safeguarding and Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) procedures.
- Submit collected data and related documentation within established deadlines, reporting any challenges encountered during outreach or data collection.

**B. Coordination and organisational support**

- Participate in internal project meetings and coordination meetings with consortium partners, as required.
- Be available to undertake weekly field visits.

## **3. Required Qualifications and Experience**

**Education**

- High school diploma required; a degree in Social Sciences or a related field will be considered an asset.

**Professional Experience and Technical Skills**

- At least two years of relevant professional experience in outreach, community engagement or beneficiary identification within development or protection projects.
- Good knowledge of the Jordanian socio-economic context, particularly at the local level.
- Experience working on projects funded by the Italian Agency for Development Cooperation (AICS) will be considered an asset.
- Good organisational and planning skills, including the ability to prioritise tasks, manage deadlines and respond to implementation challenges.
- Good command of IT tools and standard office software. Experience with KoboToolbox or other data collection and management software is considered an asset.
- Valid driving licence and ability to drive in Jordan.

**Languages**

- Advanced proficiency in Arabic, both written and spoken.
- Proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

**Personal and Interpersonal Skills**

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to work constructively with people from diverse backgrounds.
- A proactive, solution-oriented approach and the ability to respond effectively to challenges.
- A strong sense of responsibility, attention to detail and commitment to meeting deadlines.
- Commitment to social inclusion, child protection, gender equality and the rights and dignity of vulnerable and marginalised people.
- Willingness and availability to travel regularly to project locations outside Amman.

## **4. Contractual Conditions**

- **Duty station:** Amman, Jordan.
- **Contract duration:** 15 months.
- **Expected starting date:** December 2026.
- **Gross monthly salary:** JOD 800–950, depending on the candidate’s qualifications and relevant experience.

jobs.title: Advocacy Mobile Implementation Advisor (m/f/x) – MSF Belgium
jobs.description:
**CONTEXT**

In the current landscape of growing humanitarian needs, compounded political, environmental, and economic crises, and shrinking humanitarian space, MSF teams play a key role in maintaining MSF’s relevance and impact and in positively influencing the overall response to communities’ medical and humanitarian needs by authorities and humanitarian actors.

While MSF country programmes have capacity for leverage this potential is often underused due to insufficient analysis and a lack of well-resourced advocacy strategies with clear follow-up mechanisms.

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES**

This position is jointly managed by the Operations Department and the Analysis Department, and its main purpose is to provide targeted, time-bound support to country programmes. This includes analysing humanitarian contexts, defining positioning and advocacy objectives, developing data collection frameworks for advocacy, and contributing to the development of advocacy strategies and products.

More specifically, the Advocacy Mobile Implementation Advisor can provide:

**1. Direct support to Operations**

- Support humanitarian analysis, including actor mapping and stakeholders power analysis
- Support the definition or revision of advocacy objectives and priorities, providing input for new or existing advocacy plans, engagement and influencing strategies
- Collect and analyse data and develop advocacy products, such as talking points, briefing notes, reports, and public communication initiatives in collaboration with the Communication Department
- Contribute to external engagement activities at the request of Operations
- Support emergency advocacy during acute or evolving crises by disseminating timely advocacy materials and by providing rapid analysis
- Organise or support learning activities at project level for increased awareness and capacity for humanitarian analysis and advocacy
- Support the recruitment and onboarding of new humanitarian affairs staff, provide guidance and support to existing staff, in complementarity with the Humanitarian Learning and Development Coordinator

**2. Support for the development of knowledge products and learning solutions**

- Contribute to the formalization and dissemination of good practices and the development of new humanitarian affairs tools
- Contribute to the review of advocacy approaches and practices
- Support the development of advocacy methodologies informed by anti-racism, diversity, equality, and inclusion principles
- Contribute to the design and implementation of the learning solutions offered by the Analysis department

**REQUIREMENTS**

**Education & Experience**

- Political, Social Sciences or Public Health degree at postgraduate level
- Minimum 2 years of international MSF experience in humanitarian affairs and advocacy in different contexts
- Experience in data production & management
- Experience in other NGOs is an asset
- Experience in mentoring and/or coaching is a strong asset

**Competencies**

- Strong analytical skills
- Excellent writing skills
- Ability to use data responsibly, safely, and ethically
- Strong mentoring and coaching skills
- Strong communication and teamwork skills
- Flexibility and adaptability to working in diverse settings and with diverse priorities
- Cross cultural awareness
- Strong understanding and ability to promote humanitarian principles

**Languages**

- Proficiency in **English and French**, both written and spoken, is mandatory

**CONDITIONS**

- Expected starting date: January 2027
- Location\*: Brussels (Belgium)

\**Due to administrative constraints, given the duration of the contract, candidates may need to already have the permanent right and/or a valid work permit to work in the mentioned locations.*

*\*Other location/s where there is an MSF entity could be discussed in exceptional cases. The outcome will depend on the candidate's residency, the local legal restrictions (residency, work permit, etc.), and the agreement with the host MSF entity of the location.*

- Type of contract: Fixed-term contract – Full-time
- Duration of contract: 1 year (possibility of extension)
- Mobility: up to 70% of the time in MSF projects worldwide
- Salary according to MSF mobile staff salary grid
- High mobility allowance
- The contractual terms, conditions and salary will be established according to the official residence of the selected candidate and in respect of MSF standard function and salary grid for mobile staff
- Medical insurance 100% covered as per international package; 45 days annual paid leaves
- Not a family position
- *Adhere to the MSF principles and to our managerial values: Respect, Transparency, Integrity, Accountability, Trust and Empowerment*
- *Adhere to the MSF Behavioral Commitments*

jobs.title: Coordinateur de site et du consortium Fonds Humanitaire (F/H) - République Centrafricaine
jobs.description:
Vous souhaitez intégrer une association militante et agir concrètement pour plus de justice sociale ?

Médecins du Monde agit depuis plus de 40 ans pour soigner les populations les plus vulnérables, dénoncer les entraves à l’accès aux soins et faire évoluer durablement les politiques de santé.

En France et dans près de 30 pays, nos actions s’articulent autour de six combats politiques :

- droits et santé sexuels et reproductifs (dont le droit à l’avortement)
- migration, exil, droits et santé
- réduction des risques
- santé environnement
- droits et système de santé
- espaces humanitaires

## Médecins du Monde en RCA

La République centrafricaine (RCA) demeure confrontée à des conflits armés récurrents, entraînant une crise humanitaire majeure et de nombreuses violations des droits humains et du droit international humanitaire.

Présente dans le pays depuis 2013, Médecins du Monde (MdM) France intervient auprès des populations les plus vulnérables à travers des soins de santé dans les zones reculées, des services de santé sexuelle et reproductive, la prise en charge des survivant·e·s de violences basées sur le genre (VBG) et le déploiement de cliniques mobiles d’urgence. En 2025, ses interventions ont bénéficié à 278 113 personnes.

Récemment, MdM a renforcé sa présence opérationnelle avec le lancement, en novembre 2024, d’un projet à Batangafo dédié à la prise en charge de la malnutrition aiguë sévère chez les enfants et des survivant·e·s de VBG. En mars 2026, une nouvelle base a été ouverte dans la sous-préfecture de Kabo, grâce au financement de la DG ECHO, afin d’appuyer six formations sanitaires, dont l’hôpital secondaire, pour une durée de seize mois.

Pour les prochaines années, MdM prévoit d’accroître ses activités, ses financements et sa couverture géographique, tout en consolidant son positionnement comme acteur de référence dans le domaine de la santé, notamment en matière de prévention et de prise en charge des VBG. L’organisation poursuit également sa collaboration avec les autres ONG internationales afin de renforcer la coordination humanitaire, le partage d’informations et l’efficacité des interventions.

## Pourquoi nous avons besoin de vous

En tant que coordinateur de site et du consortium Fonds Humanitaire (F/H), vous aurez pour principales missions de piloter et de coordonner la stratégie et la mise en œuvre des programmes du consortium Fonds Humanitaire à Batangafo, Bouca, Kabo et Sido, en animant les équipes et les partenaires, en garantissant l'application des procédures MdM et en développant le plaidoyer et les partenariats.

Vous assurerez l’animation du consortium entre MdM et Solidarités International sur la base.

## Vos missions

Plus spécifiquement, vos responsabilités seront les suivantes:

## 1. Coordination, représentation et partenariats

- Représenter MdM auprès des autorités, acteurs humanitaires, bailleurs, partenaires techniques et forces présentes dans la zone d’intervention
- Participer aux mécanismes de coordination, ateliers, conférences et visites institutionnelles afin de renforcer le positionnement de MdM
- Assurer des relations régulières avec les partenaires et veiller à la cohérence des actions menées sur la zone

## 2. Pilotage stratégique et gestion du consortium

- Diriger le consortium, animer la gouvernance, coordonner les membres et garantir une prise de décision efficace et transparente
- Définir, suivre et actualiser les plans d’action, de contingence et de suivi-évaluation (MEAL), tout en veillant à la bonne utilisation des ressources
- Produire des analyses, recommandations et retours d’expérience permettant d’améliorer la qualité des interventions et la coopération opérationnelle

## 3. Supervision opérationnelle et suivi des projets

- Organiser et coordonner les activités de la base de Batangafo, y compris les projets, la construction des infrastructures et les relations avec les partenaires
- Piloter la planification des activités, suivre les indicateurs, les échéances contractuelles et l’exécution des actions afin d’assurer leur qualité et leur conformité
- Contribuer à la définition des orientations stratégiques, assurer le reporting opérationnel et capitaliser les enseignements tirés des interventions

## 4. Gestion de la sécurité et de l’accès humanitaire

- Assurer une veille contextuelle et sécuritaire, collecter et partager les informations nécessaires à l’analyse des risques
- Élaborer, actualiser et faire appliquer les dispositifs de sécurité, tout en sensibilisant les équipes aux procédures et règles en vigueur
- Garantir l’accès humanitaire, gérer les incidents de sécurité et coordonner les réponses opérationnelles et les communications en cas de crise

## 5. Management des équipes et supervision des fonctions support

- Encadrer les équipes de la base : recrutement, intégration, fixation des objectifs, évaluation des performances, accompagnement et développement des compétences
- Favoriser la cohésion d’équipe, gérer les conflits, faire respecter les politiques internes et prendre les mesures correctives nécessaires
- Superviser les volets RH, financiers, administratifs et logistiques de la base, notamment le budget, le suivi des ressources et le respect des procédures internes

## Vos collègues

Sous la responsabilité hiérarchique du coordinateur général (F/H) basé à Bangui, vous collaborez avec l’équipe de coordination de MdM à Bangui et les chefs de base des ONGs membres du consortium ainsi le chef d’Antenne OCHA de Batangafo et tous les responsables des ONGs Internationales et nationales présente à Batangafo. Vous supervisez directement les responsables des équipes support et programmes.

## Vous êtes la bonne personne si…

- Vous êtes diplômé.e d'une formation supérieure en gestion de projet ou généraliste de l’Humanitaire
- Vous avez obligatoirement une expérience réussie de trois ans minimum sur un poste similaire de coordinateur terrain au sein d'ONGi en appui de programmes humanitaires financés par des bailleurs intstitutionnels
- Vous avez une expérience réussie en ouverture de base (fortement souhaité)
- Vous avez une expérience réussie en élaboration, conduite et évaluation de projet de santé d’urgence dans des pays et/ou zones en crise
- Vous avez une expérience réussie dans la gestion de la sécurité et de l'accès dans un contexte sécuritaire volatile
- Vous avez une expérience significative en management d'équipe
- Vous êtes capable d'arbitrer en cas de dilemme de manière structurée et méthodique
- Vous savez faire preuve de proactivité, d'organisation et de planification
- Vous parlez couramment le français et l'anglais
- Vous avez une bonne maîtrise du Pack Office et des outils de travail collaboratifs

## Ce poste n’est pas pour vous si...

- Vous craignez ne pas vous retrouver dans les valeurs et le positionnement militant de Médecins du Monde
- Vous ne vous sentez pas à l'aise pour vivre et travailler dans des conditions de vie relativement simples, voire spartiates
- Vous n'avez pas d'expérience de travail en équipe interculturelle et multidisciplinaire
- Vous ne savez pas faire preuve de patience, diplomatie et pédagogie

## **Les prochaines étapes**

Si votre candidature est sélectionnée, nous vous contacterons rapidement pour vous proposer un entretien RH avec un.e chargé.e de recrutement. Les entretiens, technique et managérial, auxquels des cas pratiques pourront éventuellement être intégrés, auront lieu dans le courant du mois de novembre.

Dans le cadre de la lutte contre le blanchiment et le financement du terrorisme, des vérifications d’antécédents sur listes internationales pourront être effectuées. Les données sont traitées de façon confidentielle et sécurisée. Plus d’infos : [http://bit.ly/3CSThBs](http://bit.ly/3CSThBs)

Un extrait de casier judiciaire (B3) sera demandé à toute personne recrutée.

## Nous attendons votre candidature

Nous n’avons besoin que de votre CV et de votre lettre de motivation.

Si vous pensez correspondre à ce poste, postulez !

## Vos conditions d’emploi

**Contrat & statut :**

- Salaire brut mensuel 3 663 €
- CDD à pourvoir à partir du 1er novembre jusqu'au 30/08/2027 (non glissant)
- Départ seul

Cadre de travail :

- Poste basé à Batangafo
- Déplacements à prévoir sur la zone du projet (Sido, Batangafo Kabo et Bouca) et à Bangui

Les avantages :

- 13e mois (pour les salarié.e.s ayant plus de 6 mois d’ancienneté)
- Prime d’expatriation de 10% du salaire brut par mois
- Prise en charge du transport (domicile – mission), des visas, des vaccins
- Hébergement: vous serez hébergé.e en guest house (bon niveau de confort)
- Politique R&R: tous les trois mois
- Assurance santé (participation à 50% de MdM et 50% du salarié)
- Assurance rapatriement
- MdM favorise la formation et la mobilité interne

Les indispensables :

- 5 semaines de congés + 22,5 RTT par an
- Engagement fort en faveur de l’inclusion et de la lutte contre toutes les discriminations
- Plus d’infos : [https://bit.ly/3x5MezL](https://bit.ly/3x5MezL)

Diversité et inclusion

MdM s’engage pour l’insertion des personnes en situation de handicap et lutte contre toutes les discriminations.

Si vous bénéficiez d’une reconnaissance de la qualité de travailleur.se handicapé.e et/ou si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement de poste, n’hésitez pas à nous en faire part.

jobs.title: National Technical Consultant –Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**POSITION INFORMATION**

- **Organization:** UNDP Lebanon Through Stars Orbit Consultants and Management Development
- **VA No.: UNDP/LBN/VA26/207**
- **Position Title**: National Technical Consultant – Electrical Engineer
- **Duty Station:** Dbayeh, Tyr and Adloun with occasional meetings at UNDP offices if need be.
- **Duration:** 4 months (without exceeding 6 working days per month)
- **Vacancy Date of Issue: 27 October 2026**
- **Vacancy Closure Date: 03 November 2026**
- **National or International consultancy:** National consultancy

To review the full Terms of Reference (TOR), please follow link:

[https://drive.google.com/file/d/1l7n3ymgwhCqXmBtEfHyHwMjbRZk0qOCD/view?usp=drive_link](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1l7n3ymgwhCqXmBtEfHyHwMjbRZk0qOCD/view?usp=drive_link)

**BACKGROUND**

UNDP, through its Rule of Law and community security programming, has been supporting national and local institutions in Lebanon to strengthen the delivery of security and public services and promote safer and more resilient communities. This support includes interventions implemented in coordination with the Ministry of Interior and Municipalities (MoIM), the Internal Security Forces (ISF), municipalities, and other relevant local stakeholders. Through consultations, field assessments, and engagement with local authorities and security institutions, inadequate public lighting and unreliable access to electricity have been identified as important challenges affecting the safety, accessibility, and functionality of public spaces and security facilities. These challenges have become increasingly significant in the context of Lebanon's prolonged electricity and energy constraints. In response, UNDP is supporting the implementation of street-lighting and solar-energy interventions in Tyre, Marina Dbayeh, and Adloun ISF Station. The interventions are intended to improve lighting and safety in targeted public areas while promoting reliable and energy-efficient solutions adapted to the operational needs of the respective locations.

Given the technical nature of these interventions, appropriate electrical assessments, technical specifications, and quality control are required to ensure that the proposed systems are suitable for the site conditions, technically sound, safe, and implemented in accordance with the approved designs and specifications.

Accordingly, UNDP intends to recruit an Electrical Engineer Consultant to provide technical support for the interventions in Tyre, Marina Dbayeh, and Adloun ISF Station. The consultant will be responsible for preparing the required technical baseline studies and assessments, including identifying the electrical and lighting requirements of the targeted locations and developing the necessary technical specifications and related documentation.

**SCOPE OF WORK, RESPONSIBILITIES AND DESCRIPTION OF THE PROPOSED ANALYTICAL WORK**

Under the supervision of the Senior Project Officer and the Director General of the Directorate of Municipalities and local authorities in Lebanon, the consultant will be responsible for:

- Carry out a site visit and quality evaluation for the condition of the street lighting poles in Tyre.
- Meet with Antelias and Dbayeh municipality to collect the needed information of the street lighting in Marina Dbayeh.
- Submit a detailed plan and specs for installing solar panels for street lighting poles in Marina Dbayeh.
- Conduct site visits to Marina Dbayeh to oversee the implementation of the works.
- Evaluation of finalized works in respect to the public safety regulations and good practice.
- Prepare a BoQ and Technical Baseline study for solar system at Adloun ISF Station.
- Conduct site visits to ADLOUN ISF Station to oversee the implementation of the works.

**EXPECTED OUTPUTS AND DELIVERABLES**

The consultant is expected to complete the above tasks and activities, noting that the total duration is 4 months without exceeding 6 working days per month.

**INSTITUTIONAL ARRANGEMENTS**

- The consultant will work under the overall guidance of the Governance and Rule of Law Chief Technical Advisor/Project Officer.
- The title rights, copyrights and all other rights whatsoever nature in any material produced under the provisions of this TOR will be vested exclusively in UNDP. UNDP has full ownership of the activity and of its final product. Thus, any public mention (including through social media) about the activity should state clearly that ownership. In addition, any public appearance related to the activity should be coordinated and approved by UNDP.
- UNDP will be responsible for providing the contractor with all necessary materials related to the project in a timely, thorough, and transparent manner. UNDP will be also responsible for providing clarifications and facilitation of work.
- The consultant shall rely on his/her own means of communication and shall commute from/to place of residence to duty station at his own expense.

**DURATION OF WORK**

The assigned duration for this consultancy is 4 months without exceeding 6 working days per month.

The mission is expected to commence immediately after contract signature and be completed within 4 months from the contract signature date.

The time needed to review/comment/approve deliverables and outputs is (5) five working days.

**DUTY STATION**

The assignment is based at Dbayeh, Tyr and Adloun with occasional meetings at UNDP offices if need be.

**STANDARD MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

- **Education:** Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering.
- **Experience:** At least 2 years of experience working with municipalities and Internal security forces.
- **Language:** Fluent in Arabic and English.

**“The Personnel will be covered with Health insurance and Personal accident insurance; the fees shall be deducted from personnel's monthly payment”.**

jobs.title: Protection Program Manager in Cabo Delgado
jobs.description:
**1. Context & Background**

Helpcode has been operating in Mozambique since 1988, implementing emergency response and development co-operation interventions across Cabo Delgado, Maputo, Sofala, Manica, and Inhambane provinces. In Cabo Delgado, Helpcode has been present since 2021 in response to the ongoing humanitarian emergency driven by the armed conflict and resulting displacement.

The organization operates a consolidated multi-sectoral emergency response with a strong core focus on Protection (including protection monitoring, referrals, prevention, mitigation, and response to gender-based violence, child protection, and women’s socio-economic empowerment). The current protection response is composed of a portfolio of synergistic projects funded by ECHO, OCHA, and private donors. Operating in a volatile security context with access constraints, Helpcode ensures the highest standards of staff safety and programme quality.

**2. Purpose of the Role**

Under the direct supervision of the Head of Program based in Pemba and with technical support from the HQ Protection Specialist, the Protection Program Manager is responsible for the overall operational management, weekly/monthly field planning, human resources supervision, technical quality, and external representation of Helpcode’s Protection Programme in Cabo Delgado.

The Manager ensures the smooth execution of multi-donor synergistic protection projects (ECHO, OCHA, and private donors), coordinating field teams across various field offices, resolving operational and logistical bottlenecks, supervising project HR, and representing Helpcode in relevant clusters and humanitarian coordination bodies.

**3. Key Responsibilities and Tasks**

**3.1 Weekly/Monthly Planning & Field Operations Management**

- **Operational Roll-out & Workplans:** Collect, consolidate, and review weekly and monthly operational action plans submitted by field office focal points/coordinators across Cabo Delgado.
- **Logistical Problem-Solving:** Identify and proactively resolve operational and logistical bottlenecks (e.g., vehicle allocation, field movement constraints, communication tools, supply delivery) in coordination with logistics.
- **Synergy & Coherence:** Ensure ECHO, OCHA, and private donor-funded protection projects are implemented in full synergy, avoiding overlaps and maximizing coverage.
- **Field Monitoring:** Conduct regular, structured field visits to supervise activity roll-out, monitor quality standards, and provide direct implementation support.

**3.2 Team Management & Human Resources Supervision**

- **HR Supervision:** Directly supervise project HR (national staff, field protection officers, social workers, case workers, community facilitators) across all protection interventions in Cabo Delgado.
- **Performance & Coordination:** Set clear objectives, conduct periodic performance evaluations, and establish daily/weekly team coordination mechanisms.
- **Recruitment:** Lead and manage national protection staff recruitment in close coordination with HR and Head of Program.
- **Capacity Building:** Identify training needs and organize initiatives with HQ Protection Specialist (e.g., Protection Mainstreaming, GBV Case Management, PSS, Child Protection, Safeguarding).
- **Compliance & Conduct:** Ensure adherence to Helpcode’s HR policies, Code of Conduct, PSEA protocols, and Child Safeguarding policies.

**3.3 Technical Quality, MEAL & Reporting**

- **Technical Quality Control:** Ensure protection interventions adhere to international humanitarian standards (Sphere, CPMS, GBV Minimum Standards) and Helpcode internal technical guidelines.
- **Project Reporting:** Lead drafting and timely submission of high-quality internal and external reports (monthly progress, intermediate, and final donor reports for ECHO, OCHA, and private donors).
- **Visibility:** Ensure project visibility requirements are fully met in compliance with donor (ECHO, OCHA) and Helpcode guidelines.
- **MEAL & Data Protection:** Oversee data collection, protection monitoring tools, and complaint & feedback mechanisms (AAP), enforcing strict confidentiality protocols.

**3.4 Coordination, Cluster Participation & External Representation**

- **Cluster Representation:** Proactively represent Helpcode in the regional Protection Cluster, GBV Sub-Cluster, Child Protection AoR, and sub-working groups in Cabo Delgado.
- **Stakeholder Engagement:** Act as main technical and operational focal point vis-à-vis UN agencies (UNHCR, UNICEF, UNFPA, OCHA), local/provincial authorities, and NGOs.
- **Referral Pathways:** Coordinate bilaterally with key humanitarian actors to establish functional referral pathways, prevent duplication, and promote complementary interventions.

**3.5 Financial, Procurement & Security Oversight**

- **Budget Monitoring:** Monitor project expenditure and budget burn rates across ECHO, OCHA, and private donor budgets in coordination with finance.
- **Procurement Tracking:** Prepare and track procurement plans for protection supplies, dignity kits, or community structures following donor and internal procedures.
- **Security & Context Monitoring:** Ensure full compliance of field teams with Helpcode security SOPs and movement protocols in volatile zones; continuously monitor context and report risks immediately.

**4. Qualifications & Requirements**

- **Field Experience:** Minimum of 2 years of relevant field experience in humanitarian, early recovery, or development programs.
- **Project Management:** Proven experience in project and program management, team leadership, and field operations.
- **Donor Relations:** Experience in donor relations, cluster coordination, and stakeholder engagement.
- **Language Skills:** Fluency in both Portuguese and English (spoken and written) is mandatory.
- **Soft Skills:** Strong interpersonal skills, ability to work effectively in a multicultural environment, and demonstrated problem-solving skills using creative approaches.
- **Assets:** Previous experience working in Mozambique and dedicated experience in the protection sector are considered strong assets.

jobs.title: Project Manager / Consortium Coordinator

jobs.description:
Project Manager / Consortium Coordinator
**Project:** Nabni – Building for Peace Project
**Consortium Partners:** AMAL and The Day After (TDA)
**Duty Station:** Aleppo or Damascus, with regular travel to project locations in Hama Governorate
**Contract Duration:** 12 months
**Expected Start Date:** asap but no later than 01/01/2027

**Important Note:** This position is being recruited in anticipation of the proposed project. Appointment and contract issuance are subject to final donor approval and confirmation of project funding.

## **About AMAL Orgnaization For Relief& Development**

Amal is a non-profit Syrian non-governmental organization established and registered in Turkey on 6/6/2014, to provide life-saving aid and services to the most vulnerable people, strengthening their resilience, advocating for their basic rights, and also contributing to providing recovery and revitalization programs for societies that war turned

**Position Summary**

AMAL is seeking a qualified **Project Manager / Consortium Coordinator** to lead AMAL’s implementation of the proposed Nabni project while coordinating the overall consortium partnership between AMAL and TDA.

The position has a dual function:

1. **Project Manager for AMAL**, responsible for the planning, implementation, monitoring, coordination and reporting of AMAL-led project components, particularly infrastructure, service-delivery and related activities; and
2. **Consortium Coordinator**, responsible for ensuring effective coordination, information sharing, joint planning and consolidated follow-up across AMAL and TDA.

The position will work closely with technical, engineering, MEAL, finance, procurement, environmental and social, field and programme teams, as well as with consortium partners, Nabni representatives, local authorities, service providers and community stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Project Management and Implementation**

- Lead the day-to-day management and implementation of AMAL’s project responsibilities in accordance with the approved proposal, workplan, budget and donor requirements.
- Develop and regularly update detailed implementation plans, activity schedules, procurement plans and expenditure forecasts.
- Ensure timely implementation of infrastructure, service-delivery and other AMAL-led activities.
- Coordinate closely with engineering, procurement, finance, MEAL and E&S teams to ensure that technical and programme activities remain aligned.
- Track project progress, identify delays or implementation constraints and coordinate corrective actions.
- Ensure that feasibility assessments, technical designs, Bills of Quantities, procurement processes and implementation schedules are completed and coordinated appropriately.
- Ensure project activities follow approved technical, environmental, social, safeguarding and conflict-sensitivity requirements.
- Maintain organized project documentation and ensure key decisions, approvals and changes are properly recorded.

**2. Consortium Coordination**

- Serve as the principal coordination focal point between AMAL and TDA for overall project implementation.
- Facilitate regular consortium coordination meetings and ensure agreed actions are documented and followed up.
- Maintain a consolidated project workplan covering the activities and dependencies of both consortium partners.
- Coordinate sequencing between the three project pathways: social cohesion, infrastructure/service delivery and inclusive local governance.
- Ensure that activities implemented by the two partners complement one another and contribute to the agreed Theory of Change and results framework.
- Coordinate preparation of joint progress updates, reports, presentations and other consortium-level deliverables.
- Support resolution of operational or coordination issues between consortium members in a constructive and timely manner.
- Ensure information relevant to project implementation, risks, changes and donor requirements is communicated consistently across the consortium.

**3. Donor and External Coordination**

- Act as a key programme focal point for coordination with Nabni and other relevant project stakeholders, in coordination with AMAL management.
- Support preparation and submission of narrative reports, workplans, progress updates and other donor-requested documentation.
- Coordinate responses to donor comments and follow up on agreed actions.
- Participate in coordination meetings, workshops, monitoring visits and project reviews.
- Support coordination with relevant local authorities, service institutions, community representatives and humanitarian/development coordination structures.
- Ensure proposed changes to activities, sites, budgets or implementation arrangements are identified early and processed through the appropriate approval mechanisms.

**4. Programme Quality, MEAL and Accountability**

- Ensure implementation remains aligned with the project Theory of Change, logical framework and agreed indicators.
- Work closely with MEAL colleagues to monitor progress toward outputs, outcomes and targets.
- Promote meaningful community participation and ensure community feedback informs implementation where appropriate.
- Support implementation of the project Complaints and Feedback Mechanism in coordination with the MEAL team.
- Ensure lessons learned, implementation challenges and good practices are documented and used to improve delivery.
- Promote conflict-sensitive, inclusive and do-no-harm approaches throughout project implementation.

**5. Risk, Compliance and Safeguarding**

- Monitor key programme, operational, financial, security and contextual risks and ensure appropriate mitigation measures are followed.
- Ensure environmental and social requirements are integrated into planning, procurement and implementation.
- Coordinate with technical and E&S colleagues on contractor compliance, occupational health and safety, community safety and other relevant requirements.
- Ensure serious incidents or significant project risks are escalated promptly in accordance with organizational and donor procedures.
- Promote safeguarding, protection from sexual exploitation and abuse, non-discrimination and respectful conduct throughout project implementation.

**6. Team Coordination**

- Coordinate the work of project staff and facilitate effective collaboration between technical and programme functions.
- Provide clear priorities, guidance and follow-up to project team members.
- Support problem solving and capacity development within the project team.
- Promote a collaborative working environment between AMAL and TDA teams.

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Essential**

- Bachelor’s degree in project management, development studies, engineering, social sciences, public administration, international development or another relevant field.
- At least **5 years of relevant professional experience**, including substantial experience in project or programme management.
- Demonstrated experience coordinating multi-disciplinary teams and managing complex project workplans.
- Experience working with humanitarian, recovery, development or peacebuilding projects.
- Strong experience in donor reporting, project planning and results-based management.
- Ability to coordinate effectively with partners, authorities, communities and technical teams.
- Strong organizational, communication, facilitation and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to manage multiple workstreams and deadlines simultaneously.
- Strong Arabic and English communication skills, both written and spoken.
- Good command of Microsoft Office and common project-management and reporting tools.

**Desirable**

- Previous experience coordinating a consortium or partnership involving multiple organizations.
- Experience with infrastructure rehabilitation, service-delivery or early-recovery programming.
- Familiarity with social cohesion, conflict sensitivity, community engagement or local governance programming.
- Familiarity with environmental and social safeguards and community accountability mechanisms.
- Experience working in Hama Governorate or similar contexts.

**Key Competencies**

- Leadership and coordination
- Planning and organization
- Partnership management
- Clear communication
- Problem solving and decision-making
- Results orientation
- Conflict sensitivity
- Accountability and integrity
- Ability to work collaboratively across technical and programme teams

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES AND NON-DISCRIMINATION:**

Amal is dedicated to promoting equal opportunities in our recruitment practices so maintaining equal opportunities and nondiscrimination is a foundational principle:

Discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, age, disability, social status, origin, pregnancy, genetic characteristics, or any other grounds is strictly prohibited across all aspects of employment, organizational practices, work arrangements, salary, dismissal, and service provision.

Preference among employees or candidates for employment may be granted based on objective criteria and qualifications essential for the job, and such preferences do not constitute discrimination.

In instances where specific provisions apply to contracting concerning gender, qualifications, working conditions, or contract type (daily, weekly, seasonal), rights and responsibilities remain equitable

**PROTECTION FROM HARASSMENT AND SEXUAL EXPLOITATION:**

Amal Organization is dedicated to fostering a secure and respectful environment for employees and those they interact with in the course of their work. The recruitment, retention, and promotion of staff are inherently tied to maintaining high ethical standards and a commendable reputation. Amal Organization unequivocally prohibits and will not tolerate (zero tolerate) any form of discrimination, abuse, harassment (whether sexual or otherwise), based on race, ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, age, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship status, disability, or military status. Employees and associated personnel must strictly refrain from engaging in any discriminatory, harassing, or abusive behavior, whether physical, sexual, verbal, or otherwise, both within and outside the Amal organization.

**CHILD SAFEGUARDING:**

Amal Organization recognizes that ensuring a secure environment for children begins with the recruitment of qualified employees equipped with the necessary competencies and skills to perform their duties effectively, safely, and reliably. This commitment is geared towards safeguarding children from all forms of exploitation, labour, or potential harm.

In our dedication to children's safety, our selection process incorporates comprehensive background checks, underscoring our unwavering commitment to preventing abuse and ensuring the well-being of children.

**SAFEGUARDING EMPLOYEE RELATIONS:**

In line with our commitment to fostering a secure and respectful work environment, the post holder is required to adhere to Amal's anti-harassment policy. This policy underscores our dedication to safeguarding the well-being of our staff by promoting a workplace culture characterized by mutual respect and professionalism. The role holder plays a vital part in this commitment, ensuring a supportive atmosphere and actively contributing to the safeguarding of their colleagues through the promotion of positive employee relations.

jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS) professional with a passion for advancing evidence-based MHPSS practice in humanitarian settings? Danish Red Cross (DRC) is looking for a MHPSS Advisor to provide technical expertise, capacity development, and quality assurance to the Red Cross Red Crescent National Societies (RCRC) National Societies delivering community-based MHPSS interventions in humanitarian settings.

**About the position and the assignments**

You will be based at the Danish Red Cross HQ in Copenhagen and will be part of the Health Team in the Technical Quality and Impact Unit of the International Department. The Health Team comprises technical advisors within health and mental health and psychosocial support. It ensures the availability of the necessary technical capacities to provide timely and relevant assistance and advice to DRC-supported operations, with a primary focus on the Africa, while also supporting MHPSS interventions in MENA, Europe and Asia regions as needed.

As a member of the Health Team, you will be working under the line management of the Health Team Lead and will also work closely with other colleagues at the DRC HQ and Regional and Country Offices (COs), as well as with NSs staff and volunteers. You will also collaborate with the colleagues from the International Federation of the Red Cross Red Crescent (IFRC) and the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC). The position does not have programme management responsibilities but supports programmes through technical accompaniment, mentoring, and quality assurance.

**Your main responsibilities will be to:**

- Strategic planning and direction: Contribute to defining and rollout of DRC’s strategic directions within MHPSS in humanitarian settings. Support development and rollout of strategies, policies, and technical frameworks for MHPSS in humanitarian settings.
- Technical support and guidance: Provide evidence-based guidance and advice to DRC COs and National Societies on MHPSS priorities, approaches and activities, remotely or through country visits and missions to ensure that MHPSS interventions follow industry standards and good practice. Support development or adaptation and rollout of relevant technical tools and guidelines to meet operational needs.
- Strengthening of capacities: Support National Societies in assessing technical capacity needs, and in designing and implementing capacity-strengthening plans, including trainings, coaching, mentoring, and technical supervision.
- Program monitoring and evaluation: Support planning and undertaking of assessments, baselines, endlines, reviews and evaluations, and monitoring of MHPSS interventions.
- Advocacy: In close collaboration with relevant humanitarian diplomacy (HD) colleagues, contribute to DRC’s policy influencing, advocacy and HD efforts on MHPSS in humanitarian settings.
- Resource mobilisation: Support proposal development by contributing to the design and quality assurance of MHPSS components in the project proposals that align with donor requirements and organisational goals and priorities.
- Partnerships and collaboration: Foster thematic partnerships and joint MHPSS initiatives within the RCRC Movement and with external stakeholders.
- Surge deployments: Undertake MHPSS surge/deployments in support of DRC bi-lateral operations and wider RCRC Movement responses, including multilateral deployments with the ICRC and the IFRC.

**Your profile**

We are looking for an experienced MHPSS professional with at least five years of experience working on community-based MNHPSS with humanitarian and development organisations, including at least three years in international postings in Africa and MENA regions. You hold a master's degree, or equivalent experience, in MHPSS, social sciences, or another relevant field. You have sound technical, strategy and advisory skills within community-based MHPSS in humanitarian settings and migration. You have proven experience developing and adapting technical guidance, tools and training materials, as well as designing and facilitating capacity-development initiatives for staff and volunteers of partner organisations.

You have experience supporting assessments, technical reviews, evaluations, and the development of quality assurance processes for community-based MHPSS interventions. You are an excellent facilitator and communicator with strong interpersonal and cross-cultural skills. You work collaboratively, are well organised, and are able to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines. You are willing and able to undertake field missions, including emergency deployments, with travel of up to four months per year. Professional working proficiency in both English and French is required. Experience of working for the International RCRC Movement is considered an asset.

**We offer**

A job with an opportunity to improve the lives of the most vulnerable people around the world. We further offer a unique opportunity to influence the strategic development and mainstreaming of MHPSS in humanitarian settings.

The position is a full-time position - 37 working hours per week. The position is 12 months with possibility for extension.

Salary and employment conditions are in accordance with Danish Red Cross’s collective bargaining agreement with HK and AC, depending on experience and qualifications. The position is based at the Danish Red Cross headquarters in Copenhagen and requires on-site presence. As this is a national position based in Denmark, the salary package does not include relocation assistance to Denmark and housing or family-related allowances.

**Your future workplace**

The International Red Cross and Red Crescent network is the largest humanitarian network in the world, with a presence and activities in almost every country. All Red Cross and Red Crescent activities have one central purpose: to help those who suffer, without discrimination, whether during conflict, in response to natural or man-made disasters, or due to conditions of chronic poverty. Our work is guided by seven fundamental principles: humanity, impartiality, independence, voluntary service, unity, and universality.

DRC’s international department’s approx. 300 staff supporting RCRC NSs with planning and implementing humanitarian and development interventions in some of the most challenging contexts in 20 countries across Africa, MENA, Asia, and Europe.

We offer a meaningful work at a purpose-driven workplace with truly engaged colleagues. We focus on professional challenges, well-being and a flexible organising of your work life. All of us contribute to a great work environment and colleagueship.

jobs.description:
## Terms of Reference

Consultancy term: 9 days

Consultancy dates: 9 November - 2 December 2026

### Overview

Conciliation Resources is seeking an external consultant to support a refresh of our organisational communication strategy for the period 2026-2030, bringing it in line with the objectives in our [Strategic Plan](https://www.c-r.org/learning-hub/building-peace-world-preparing-war-strategic-plan-2026-2030). We are looking for someone with experience in communications strategy and implementation in the international NGO sector to provide us with independent and fresh ideas for our forward communications approach.

### About Conciliation Resources

Conciliation Resources (CR) is an international organisation committed to stopping violent conflict and creating more peaceful societies. We work with people impacted by war and violence, bringing diverse voices together to make change that lasts. We connect the views of people on the ground with political processes and share experience and expertise so others can find creative responses to conflict. We are a registered charity founded in 1994.

### Background to the assignment

CR is updating its communications strategy so that it aligns with the priorities and goals in our 2026-2030 Strategic Plan (in particular Goal 9, to ‘communicate confidently, and to new audiences, stories that support peacebuilding and mediation’). Our current strategy was developed in 2021 and both the external environment and our internal capacities and structures have changed since then.

The light-touch refresh exercise will assess the analysis we already have, priority audiences, channels, brand and content, as well as capacities and approach. It will review progress against our anti-racist communications and development plan. It will set out revised priorities for our external communications, identify the capacities we need to deliver on them and guide the work of the communications team, which currently comprises a Senior Communications Manager and a Communications Officer. We do not envisage significant growth in our communications team and internal capacity in the foreseeable future.

### Scope of the work

The consultant will:

- Support the communications team with audience analysis: assessing who we should be appealing to, what we want audiences to do, and whether we are communicating to our audiences in the right way.
- Review written data compiled internally through reflection and analysis, in particular, updated context analysis and progress reviews, peer analysis, audiences and personas, staff feedback on needs and internal capacity.
- Develop, present and discuss feedback on findings, including to executive management, make suggestions on ambition and adaptations in channels, tools and approach, and capacity.

### Proposed methodology and number of days

Please see the terms of reference available at the bottom of this page.

### Timeframe, reporting and fees

Subject to timing of recruitment, the consultancy will take place between 9 November and 2 December 2026. The consultant will report to the Director of Research, Advisory and Policy overall, and work closely with the Senior Communications Manager. The exercise can be conducted remotely. Outputs will be in English.

Payment will be made upon satisfactory completion of deliverables, and within 30 days of receipt of invoices in the agreed form. Any expenses associated with the assignment will be agreed with the Director of Research, Advisory and Policy in advance and included in the invoice. All fees should be inclusive of VAT and local taxes.

### Relevant skills and expertise

- Experience of managing organisational communications teams at senior level.
- Experience of developing communications strategies in an NGO context.
- Understanding of the external environment for international development in the UK and globally, and ideally for peacebuilding.
- Understanding of gender equality and anti-racism principles and approaches and relevance to comms.
- Ability to write succinctly and identify clear, actionable recommendations.
- Well organised, good communication skills and ability to meet deadlines and communicate efficiently.
- Commitment and ability to abide by CR’s policies.
- Fluency in English.

jobs.title: Food Security and Livelihood Officer - Local Nationals Only
jobs.description:
## **Organizational Profile**

Founded in 1991, Secours Islamique France (SIF) is an International Non-governmental Organization that has responded to humanitarian and social needs in France and around the world for more than three decades. SIF supports vulnerable individuals and communities through emergency assistance, development programmes and advocacy initiatives, without discrimination or proselytism. The SIF Kenya and Somalia Mission, registered in 2012, implements humanitarian and development programmes across both countries, focusing on Education and Child Protection, Food Security and Livelihoods, and Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH).

## **Position Overview**

SIF is seeking an experienced and motivated Food Security and Livelihood Officer to support the implementation of Food Security and Livelihoods (FSL) activities under the FIFSAN funded project in Kismayo, Somalia. Based in Kismayo or Dhobley, Jubaland State, Somalia, the position involves regular field visits to Dhobley, Jamaame, and Kismayo, with travel to Nairobi as required for coordination. The successful candidate will be responsible for:

- support the planning and execution of livelihoods, agriculture, livestock, poultry, and cash-based interventions in line with approved work plans and technical standards across Kismayo, Jamaame, and Dhobley.
- facilitate transparent beneficiary identification, registration, and verification, while promoting climate-adaptive and nutrition-sensitive agriculture and household resilience.
- facilitate women-led VSLAs, financial literacy, seed capital grants, business mentorship, market linkages, and technical training and demonstrations for community-beneficiaries.
- maintain accurate activity records, collaborating with the MEAL team on data collection and feedback mechanisms, tracking project indicators, and preparing regular field progress reports.
- build effective relationships with local authorities, community structures, government extension services, and technical partners to ensure harmonized implementation and accountability.

The successful candidate should be skilled and competent in:

- strong technical expertise in climate-adaptive livelihoods, food security programming, agricultural interventions, and cash-based assistance modalities.
- practical experience in women’s economic empowerment, VSLA formation, market assessments, and small-scale enterprise support.
- familiarity with project cycle management, mobile data collection tools, reporting, and basic MEAL principles, alongside proficiency in MS Office.
- excellent planning, organizational, teamwork, and cross-cultural communication abilities to manage multiple priorities across field locations.
- fluency in English and Somali is required,

## **Do No Harm Principle**

*Secours Islamique France considers diversity a strength. We therefore review all applications, provided they demonstrate the skills required for the position to be filled. As a humanitarian NGO, SIF is committed to respecting the humanitarian principle of “Do No Harm” and ensures that the safety of our beneficiaries (including children), employees, volunteers, partners, and service providers is a primary consideration in all its activities. SIF maintains a zero-tolerance policy toward any form of fraud, corruption, psychological/sexual harassment, abuse or violence of any kind, and, more broadly, any breach of legislation, regulations, the Child Safeguarding Policy (CSP), or the internal code of conduct, both at headquarters and in the field. In line with these principles, this position is subject to a criminal record check as well as professional reference checks. Our charter is a genuine commitment: we mobilize all of our staff to promote, share, and uphold the principles set out. Together, let’s rise to the challenge for solidarity that transcends differences.*

jobs.title: Humanitarian Affairs Manager (h/f/x) - République Démocratique du Congo - MSF Belgique
jobs.description:
**CONTEXTE**

En République Démocratique du Congo (RDC), Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) travaille en collaboration avec le Ministère de la Santé afin de fournir des soins médicaux aux victimes des conflits et des violences, aux personnes déplacées ainsi qu'aux personnes affectées par des épidémies ou pandémies telles que le VIH/SIDA, la tuberculose, le paludisme, la malnutrition, entre autres. Ces situations sont souvent associées à la faiblesse des institutions étatiques, aux capacités limitées du système de santé public et à une compréhension insuffisante des besoins et des lacunes réels sur le terrain. La contribution de MSF s'appuie sur ses projets réguliers ainsi que sur ses équipes de réponse d'urgence, prêtes à intervenir sur l'ensemble du territoire en cas d'épidémie, de catastrophe naturelle ou de conflit.

En 2023, face à l'intensification de la violence dans l'Est de la RDC, qui a entraîné le déplacement d'un nombre record de civils, MSF a renforcé ses activités afin de répondre à l'augmentation des besoins humanitaires. Depuis l'année dernière, l’ensemble des programmes MSF au Nord-Kivu est confronté à d'importants défis liés aux ruptures de stocks de médicaments contre la tuberculose, le VIH et le paludisme, ainsi qu'à des pénuries d'intrants médicaux (cartouches GeneXpert, tests VIH et paludisme, etc.) et à une capacité limitée de réponse face à l'augmentation des cas de violences sexuelles, de malnutrition et d'épidémies. Le nombre élevé de déplacements de population complique également l'accès aux soins de santé. Les réductions de financement du Fonds mondial ainsi que le conflit en cours dans l'est de la RDC contribuent à ces perturbations.

En tant que **Humanitarian Affairs Manager**, vous pilotez les activités d’analyse et de plaidoyer des programmes en RDC. Membre de l’équipe de coordination, vous travaillez sous la supervision de la coordination opérationnelle et en étroite collaboration avec l’Unité Analyse et Plaidoyer du siège de MSF Belgique. Vous accompagnez les équipes opérationnelles et médicales dans la compréhension du contexte, la définition du positionnement de MSF et le développement d’initiatives de plaidoyer visant à soutenir les objectifs opérationnels des programmes.

**RESPONSABILITES PRINCIPALES**

- Définir, mettre en œuvre et coordonner l’ensemble des activités d’analyse et de plaidoyer de MSF Belgique en RDC, avec la tâche d’élaborer des stratégies de plaidoyer qui traitent des priorités médico-humanitaires associées aux besoins des programmes
- S’assurer que des éléments de plaidoyer soient inclus dans les stratégies opérationnelles des projets et des programmes
- Concevoir et appuyer la mise en œuvre de systèmes de collecte de données médicales et humanitaires qui serviront à l’analyse et au plaidoyer dans les zones d’intervention de MSF
- Superviser, en vertu des directives éthiques de MSF, la qualité de la collecte des données sur le terrain afin de fournir des informations fiables aux preneurs de décisions de MSF
- Assurer la compilation régulière de comptes rendus sur les dynamiques des systèmes de santé et d'aide humanitaire (financements, positionnement des acteurs) afin d’augmenter la capacité de levier et l’impact du plaidoyer de MSF dans le pays
- Conseiller le·la coordinateur·trice du pays ainsi que les coordinateurs·trices de projet sur le positionnement de MSF tant au niveau des projets et au niveau national, sur des thématiques ayant un impact sur les opérations, notamment les cadres de réglementation, les accords liés à l’aide et aux donateurs, les développements sanitaires, humanitaires, politiques et économiques
- Rédiger des notes de plaidoyer ponctuelles et des rapports à usage interne et externe sur les principaux sujets de préoccupation médico-humanitaire
- Définir, élaborer et réviser les messages de plaidoyer et le choix des objectifs – notamment les stratégies de communication et de diffusion – pour faire prendre conscience des problématiques médico-humanitaires et susciter des changements
- Établir des liens avec d’autres sections de MSF dans le pays afin de développer des actions de plaidoyer et des initiatives de communication entre centres opérationnels
- Appuyer le travail de réseautage en menant, ou en participant à, des fonctions de représentation (sur délégation de Coordinateur·trice du Pays), notamment auprès de la société civile locale, des groupes professionnels (associations de médecins et de personnel infirmier), du milieu académique, des acteurs humanitaires et politiques
- Formuler des recommandations pour les communications ponctuelles (non prévues) à partir de l’analyse des opérations et des activités médicales

**PREREQUIS**

**Education & Expérience**

- Formation universitaire niveau maîtrise : anthropologie, sciences sociales, sciences politiques, droit, santé publique, études sur les questions de genre et protection
- Minimum 2 ans d’expérience internationale avec une INGO médicale est requise,y compris une expérience prouvéeen tant que « Responsable Plaidoyer ou Humanitarian Affairs Manager »
- Expérience du secteur de la santé publique ainsi qu'une bonne compréhension des mécanismes de financement de la santé et du fonctionnement des systèmes de santé sont des atouts
- Expérience avec MSF est un atout

**Compétences**

- Capacité à analyser et à synthétiser des données médicales, épidémiologiques et opérationnelles
- Capacité démontrée de représentation, du réseautage, et de négociations
- Forte sensibilité interculturelle et aptitude à travailler dans des environnements multiculturels
- Résistance au stress
- Travail d’équipe et coopération
- Agilité et diplomatie
- Excellente maîtrise du Pack Office 365 est obligatoire

**Langues**

- Très bonne maitrise orale et écrite du **Français**
- Bonne connaissance d’Anglais est un atout important

**CONDITIONS**

- Date de début : **Dès que possible**
- Localisation : **Kinshasa** (RDC)
- Mobilité : 30% dans les projets et 70% en Coordination à Kinshasa
- Type de contrat : Contrat à durée déterminé – Temps plein
- Durée du contrat : **12 mois** (prolongeable)
- Salaire selon la grille salariale internationale de MSF
- Les termes contractuels, les conditions et le salaire seront établis en fonction de la résidence officielle des candidats sélectionnés et dans le respect des grilles standard de fonction et de salaire de MSF
- ***Adhésion aux valeurs managériales de l’organisation : Respect, Transparence, Responsabilisation, Intégrité, Confiance, Autonomisation***
- ***Adhésion aux engagements pour un comportement responsable***

**Date limite pour postuler : 15th of November 2026**

***Les femmes sont encouragées à postuler.***

jobs.title: Officier IT
jobs.description:
Créée en 1922, DanChurchAid (DCA) est une organisation non gouvernementale Danoise dont l’action est basée sur les droits. Installée en RCA depuis 2015, DCA fournit une assistance aux communautés les plus démunies en situation de conflit et de post-conflit au travers de son Programme d’Action Humanitaire: éducation aux risques des Armes Légères et Petit Calibres (ALPC), des Restes et Explosifs de Guerre (REG) ; Réduction de la Violence Armée (RVA) et consolidation de la paix & Support Psycho social , distribution des semences et outils, appui aux organisations de la Société Civile pour leur implication dans la réforme du Secteur de Sécurité (RSS).

DCA recherche **Un(e) Officier(e) IT** trèsexpérimentés pour participer au développement et la mise en œuvre des activités.

**OBJECTIF DU POSTE :**

Le Responsable IT doit notamment :

Garantir la disponibilité et la performance des systèmes, réseaux et équipements informatiques.

Assurer la protection des données, des systèmes et des informations sensibles de l’organisation.

Développer et mettre en œuvre un dispositif de gestion des risques informatiques et de continuité des activités.

Veiller au respect des politiques internes, des procédures de contrôle et des obligations contractuelles applicables.

Garantir un support informatique efficace au personnel de Bangui et des bases terrain.

Optimiser les ressources informatiques, les coûts et les investissements.

Renforcer les compétences informatiques du personnel et promouvoir une culture de sécurité numérique.

**RÔLES ET RESPONSABILITÉS :**

**Gouvernance informatique et planification stratégique**

- Élaborer le plan de travail du service IT, en cohérence avec les objectifs opérationnels et stratégiques de DCA-CAR.
- Évaluer périodiquement les besoins informatiques des différents départements et des bases terrain.
- Définir les priorités, les procédures et les standards techniques applicables aux infrastructures informatiques.
- Préparer le plan annuel de renouvellement et de maintenance des équipements.
- Conseiller la Direction sur les risques technologiques, les besoins d’investissement et les solutions permettant d’améliorer l’efficacité opérationnelle.
- Veiller à l’harmonisation des pratiques informatiques entre le bureau de coordination et les bases opérationnelles.
- Assurer la coordination avec le siège de DCA et les équipes IT régionales ou internationales, conformément aux responsabilités définies par l’organisation.

**Administration des systèmes, réseaux et infrastructures**

- Administrer et superviser les réseaux informatiques, les connexions Internet, les équipements réseau, les systèmes d’accès à distance et les services numériques.
- Assurer la disponibilité des systèmes de messagerie, des plateformes collaboratives, des services de stockage et des applications professionnelles.
- Superviser la configuration, les mises à jour, la maintenance et le suivi des serveurs et des postes de travail.
- Veiller à la gestion appropriée des comptes utilisateurs, des privilèges d’accès et des autorisations.
- Mettre en place une documentation technique actualisée des infrastructures et des configurations.
- Identifier les dysfonctionnements récurrents et élaborer des plans correctifs.
- Assurer le suivi des prestataires de télécommunications et des fournisseurs de services informatiques.
- Veiller à la disponibilité des solutions de communication nécessaires aux équipes humanitaires dans les zones à connectivité limitée.

**Cybersécurité et gestion des risques informatiques**

Le Responsable IT est chargé de coordonner la mise en œuvre des mesures de sécurité informatique conformément aux politiques de DCA.

À ce titre, il/elle doit :

- Mettre en œuvre les politiques de cybersécurité, de contrôle des accès et de protection des équipements.
- Assurer le déploiement et le suivi des mises à jour de sécurité, des antivirus, des pares-feux et des autres outils de protection autorisés.
- Appliquer le principe du moindre privilège en limitant les accès aux seules ressources nécessaires à chaque utilisateur.
- Veiller à l’utilisation appropriée de l’authentification multifacteur lorsque celle-ci est disponible et requise.
- Surveiller les vulnérabilités, les accès inhabituels et les risques liés aux logiciels ou équipements obsolètes.
- Organiser des campagnes de sensibilisation sur l’hameçonnage, les mots de passe, les pièces jointes suspectes et les risques liés aux supports amovibles.
- Tenir à jour un registre des risques informatiques et assurer le suivi des mesures de réduction des risques.
- Contrôler l’application des procédures de sécurité lors de l’arrivée, du départ ou du changement de fonction des employés.
- Signaler sans délai les incidents de sécurité au responsable désigné et aux équipes compétentes du siège, selon les procédures d’escalade.
- Veiller à ce que les investigations techniques soient documentées et réalisées par des personnes autorisées.

**Protection des données et conformité**

- Assurer l’application des politiques internes relatives à la confidentialité, à la classification, au stockage, au partage et à la conservation des données.
- Veiller à la protection des informations sensibles relatives au personnel, aux bénéficiaires, aux partenaires, aux finances et aux opérations humanitaires.
- Contrôler la gestion des droits d’accès aux données et la suppression ou la révocation des accès devenus inutiles.
- Veiller au respect des durées de conservation et des procédures de destruction sécurisée des données, conformément aux règles applicables.
- Appuyer les audits informatiques et les contrôles internes en fournissant la documentation et les éléments justificatifs nécessaires.
- Maintenir un registre des incidents informatiques et des incidents susceptibles d’affecter la confidentialité, l’intégrité ou la disponibilité des données.
- Participer à l’évaluation des risques liés aux nouveaux outils, logiciels, prestataires et solutions de stockage.
- Veiller à ce que les acquisitions de logiciels et de services numériques respectent les procédures d’approbation, les exigences de sécurité et les règles de gestion des licences.
- Contribuer au respect des obligations contractuelles des bailleurs et des exigences de conformité applicables, en coordination avec les départements concernés.
- Collaborer avec les responsables compétents pour le signalement des incidents impliquant des données personnelles ou sensibles.

**Continuité opérationnelle et reprise après incident**

- Élaborer et maintenir un plan de continuité des services informatiques, en coordination avec la Direction et les services concernés.
- Identifier les systèmes critiques nécessaires au fonctionnement des activités administratives, financières et programmatiques.
- Définir, avec les responsables concernés, les objectifs de temps de reprise (RTO) et les objectifs de perte maximale de données admissible (RPO).
- Mettre en œuvre des procédures de sauvegarde régulière des données critiques et vérifier leur bonne exécution.
- Organiser des tests périodiques de restauration des données et documenter les résultats.
- Prévoir des solutions de remplacement en cas de panne Internet, de défaillance matérielle, de coupure d’électricité ou d’indisponibilité d’un service essentiel.
- Établir les procédures d’escalade et de communication en cas d’incident majeur.
- Coordonner la reprise des services informatiques après un incident et assurer le suivi des mesures correctives.
- Réaliser des exercices de continuité opérationnelle et présenter les résultats à la Direction.
- Veiller à ce que les bases terrain disposent de procédures adaptées à leurs contraintes techniques et opérationnelles.

**Gestion du parc informatique et des actifs**

- Assurer la gestion du cycle de vie des équipements informatiques, de leur acquisition à leur mise hors service.
- Maintenir un inventaire centralisé, actualisé et vérifiable du matériel informatique.
- Assurer le suivi des attributions, des transferts, des réparations et des restitutions d’équipements.
- Planifier et superviser les opérations de maintenance préventive et corrective.
- Contrôler l’état du matériel et proposer les renouvellements nécessaires.
- Veiller à la conformité des logiciels installés et à la gestion des licences.
- Assurer la sécurisation des équipements lors des déplacements, des missions terrain et des changements d’affectation.
- Coordonner avec la Logistique les procédures d’acquisition, de réception, de stockage et de mise au rebut des équipements.
- Veiller à l’effacement sécurisé des données avant la réaffectation ou la mise hors service des équipements, selon les procédures autorisées.

**Support informatique et gestion des utilisateurs**

- Superviser le système de gestion des demandes d’assistance informatique.
- Veiller à la prise en charge rapide des incidents et au respect des niveaux de service définis.
- Assurer la résolution des incidents complexes et coordonner l’intervention des prestataires si nécessaire.
- Superviser l’assistance apportée par l’Assistant IT aux utilisateurs.
- Veiller à la préparation des équipements et des accès pour les nouveaux employés.
- Organiser la désactivation des comptes et la récupération du matériel lors des départs.
- Assurer la documentation des demandes, des interventions et des solutions apportées.
